cues.title: Groove & Breath Setup
cues.text: Lock in the acoustic guitar slap-groove first and let your shoulders drop before the first conversational verse line.

cues.fragment: All I hear is raindrops, falling on the rooftop
cues.title: Intimate Speech-Level Entry
cues.text: Keep the opening phrases light and speech-like over the guitar rhythm; avoid pushing volume in the lower register.

cues.fragment: Cause this pain I feel... officially missing you
cues.title: Clean Title Cadence
cues.text: Articulate each syllable of 'officially missing you' cleanly and let the final 'you' settle with gentle vibrato.

cues.fragment: But I fronted long enough to know...
cues.title: Pre-Chorus Lift
cues.text: Use forward diction (lips, teeth, tip of the tongue) to carry the line up to C4 without tensing your jaw.

cues.fragment: Ooh, can't nobody do it like you
cues.title: Chorus 1 Pocket & Sustain
cues.text: Hold the opening 'Ooh' steady (91% sustain), then keep 'every little thing you do' bouncy and right in the pocket.

cues.fragment: All I do is lay around, two years full of tears
cues.title: Verse 2 Melodic Variations
cues.text: Notice the higher melodic turns in Verse 2; separate each step of the riff cleanly rather than smearing between notes.

cues.fragment: Well, I wish that you would call me right now
cues.title: Upper-Mix Build
cues.text: Trace the upward contour with your hand as the verse climbs toward B4 so the top notes stay free and supported.

cues.fragment: Ooh, can't nobody do it like you (Chorus 2)
cues.title: Agile Chorus Embellishments
cues.text: Chorus 2 expands across 18 semitones; practice the 'officially' melisma slowly on 'mah' or 'mee' first for note separation.

cues.fragment: Well, I thought I could just get over you, baby
cues.title: Bridge Dynamic Peak
cues.text: Strongest chest-mix presence in the song: lean into 'the way you would hold me / sweet things you told me' with steady belly support.

cues.fragment: Can't nobody do it like you... officially missing you
cues.title: Chorus 3 Climax & 21-Semitone Run
cues.text: Widest range passage (up to C5): keep the throat open and let each descending R&B run note land distinctly.

cues.fragment: It's official... all I hear is raindrops
cues.title: Outro Ad-Libs & Soft Landing
cues.text: Taper back down to the intimate opening tone as the guitar fades out.
